evidence.title: Rescript — Edit video like you edit text
GitHub - wassgha/rescript: 🎬 Open source, transcript-based video/audio editor that lives in the browser. · GitHub

name: Rescript
summary: On-device, transcript-based video and audio editor: delete words to cut the footage and export locally.
description: An open-source video and audio editor that edits media like text. Whisper transcribes on-device, deleting words cuts the matching footage, filler words and silences are removed in one click, and rewritten lines can be regenerated in the speaker's own voice. Transcription, editing and export run locally with ffmpeg.wasm; desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux plus a browser app.
contains: Transcript-based editing: deleting words cuts the matching footage
One-click removal of filler words and of silences of 0.3s or longer
On-device Whisper transcription (WebGPU with WASM fallback), or import SRT, VTT or JSON captions
Regenerate a line in the speaker's voice, cloned on-device from about ten seconds of their audio
Speaker diarization groups the transcript by speaker
Export video MP4/WebM up to 4K, audio M4A/MP3/WAV, transcripts and subtitles, plus NLE/DAW timelines
Desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux (Electron) plus a browser app
Free for noncommercial use under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; commercial use needs a paid license
